title: Kazuda Xiono
description: Kazuda Xiono lived on Hosnian Prime. He was the son of a New Republic senator. An encounter with Poe Dameron led to Kaz joining the Resistance. Kaz was assigned to the Colossus platform as a spy under the guise of a mechanic. Over time, Kaz made many new allies. He played a major role in getting the Collossus into flying condition, while continuing the battle against the First Order.
